Package com.splendor.model

Class MenuOption

java.lang.Object
com.splendor.model.MenuOption
public class MenuOption extends Object
An immutable data object that describes a single entry in the player's action menu. The controller builds a list of these each turn and hands it to the view, keeping presentation details (numbering, labels, disabled-reason text) out of both the model and the view logic. The view simply renders what it receives.

  • Constructor Details

    • MenuOption

      public MenuOption(int number, MenuAction action, boolean available, String label, String detail, String reason)
      Creates a fully specified menu option.
      Parameters:
      number - The 1-based index displayed to the player.
      action - The game action this option represents.
      available - Whether the player is currently allowed to take this action.
      label - Short display name for the action (e.g. "Take 3 different").
      detail - Extra context string rendered alongside the label (e.g. list of card IDs).
      reason - Human-readable explanation of why this option is unavailable; empty when available.

      public boolean isAvailable()
      Returns whether the player is currently allowed to choose this action. When false, the view should render the option as greyed-out and show getReason().
      Returns:
      true if the action is legal for the player right now.

    • getLabel

      public String getLabel()
      Returns the short display name for this menu entry.

      Human-readable action label (e.g. "Buy visible card").

    • getDetail

      public String getDetail()
      Returns supplementary context rendered alongside the label. Examples: a list of affordable card IDs, available gem colors.
      Returns:
      Detail string; may be empty but never null.

    • getReason

      public String getReason()
      Returns the explanation shown when this option is unavailable. Empty string when the option is currently available.
      Returns:
      Reason text (e.g. "Need 3 colors in bank").
